canonical_title: d-Matrix Raptor adopts NVIDIA NVLink Fusion
treatment: Repeat only for tape-out, shipping, rack availability, customer deployment, or material architecture/performance disclosure.
known_facts: d-Matrix will integrate NVLink Fusion into Raptor inference processors for NVIDIA-compatible data-center racks.
Raptor final design is targeted by end-2026 and compatible racks for 2027.
notes: Inference accelerator interoperability with NVIDIA rack infrastructure.
